facts.value: Certain deadlines are crucial for your journey at the university. Knowing the dates allows for better planning and avoiding unnecessary hurdles.
facts.programme_association: American Studies Bachelor | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: The mentioned deadlines are exclusion periods. An application or request for enrollment submitted outside these deadlines cannot be considered.
facts.programme_association: American Studies Bachelor | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: The following deadlines also apply for applications for a higher semester, a second degree, and a change of subject or dual degree (unless specific deadlines are mentioned on the respective websites).
facts.programme_association: American Studies Bachelor | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: Information for old and new high school graduates: Uniform deadlines apply for applications directly to Goethe University – there is no distinction between old and new high school graduates.
facts.programme_association: American Studies Bachelor | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: Your higher education entrance qualification (HZB) must be fully available by the end of the application deadline. Preliminary certificates are not sufficient, and subsequent submission is not possible.
facts.programme_association: American Studies Bachelor | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: If you receive your high school diploma only after the deadline, you can apply only in the next procedure.
facts.programme_association: American Studies Bachelor | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: A distinction between old and new high school graduates only exists for nationally restricted programs (Medicine, Dentistry, Pharmacy). Here, the application is made through the Foundation for University Admissions.
facts.programme_association: American Studies Bachelor | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: Enrollment must be completed by the deadline specified in the admission notice or on the Goethe-Campus.
facts.programme_association: American Studies Bachelor | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: Please pay special attention to the documents required for enrollment, which must be submitted or uploaded on time, and transfer the semester contribution in a timely manner.
facts.programme_association: American Studies Bachelor | Goethe University Frankfurt
